title: Dev-e: Omnipod Dash: AAPSCLient showing conflicting remaining amounts
symptom: In AAPSClient after installing dev-e, there are two displays of remaining amount in Dash pod on the overview tab. The top one constantly displays 50U even when remaining amount is less. Correct remaining amount displays in next line of icons. Later, in dev-f, remaining amount only displays on top line, and when it goes to 0U it disappears completely from both lines and also in AAPS app.
